thread:
alex_support: Ticket TL-4412 — Admin console shows 'Credit applied' toast but ledger has no entry. Happening intermittently (~15% of manual grant attempts). Repro steps below, attaching curl/response we captured.

maria_ops: Can you confirm this is only manual grants from the support console and not promo code flows?

alex_support: Only manual grants so far (support console). Affects 3 customers across regions. Quick repro: 1) Support console -> Customer -> Credits -> Grant 2) Submit 1000 units 3) See success toast immediately 4) Check ledger -> no row.

alex_support: Repro curl/logs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://backoffice.internal/v1/grants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer *****" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: grant-req-20240301-abc" \
  -d '{"user_id":"cust_9x","amount":1000,"reason":"trial"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
# {"error":"rate_limited","message":"please retry"}
# headers: X-Request-ID: req_abc123, x-backoffice-node: b-3, Retry-After: <missing>
```

tim_backend: I pulled grants-service logs for that window. We're emitting 429s from the concurrency limiter (token-bucket) when db write latency spikes. Console client retries every ~200ms with no jitter which amplifies the pressure.

jenna_billing: Important: do NOT reapply credits for affected customers until we confirm ledger state and idempotency. We already have one billing complaint about mismatched balances.

deploy-bot: grants-service v2.4.1 deployed by tim_backend at 1872001200

daniel_prod: Looking at the backoffice code path — when ledger write times out we sometimes return a 200 to the UI because the grant RPC returns before ledger finalization. UI treats that as success. That's wrong; UI should wait for ledger ack or we should return 202/pending.

alex_support: Paste of a representative log segment:
"2024-11-02T15:12:02Z req=req_abc123 grants: attempting ledger insert -> timeout, ack=false"
"2024-11-02T15:12:02Z req=req_abc123 grants: returning status=200 to console (grant accepted)"
"2024-11-02T15:12:02Z req=req_abc123 ledger: async retry queued"

maria_ops: Filed UI bug RD-1023: Support console shows success toast before ledger confirm. Also created INC-7789 for the production incident.

tim_backend: Proposed mitigations: 1) Server: start returning 429 with Retry-After header when limiter hits (currently 429 body only) 2) Client: change console retry to exponential backoff with jitter (start 500ms) and honor Retry-After 3) Backoffice: make grants RPC synchronous to ledger ack for support console path or return 202 pending 4) Add stronger idempotency enforcement and logging for Idempotency-Key so we can correlate attempts. I'll push a small patch to add Retry-After and extra logging to v2.4.2.

jenna_billing: Also add a temporary mitigation: prevent the console from showing success toast for manual grants until server-side confirmation. If not possible immediately, show a 'pending' state and a link to 'check ledger'.

daniel_prod: Looks like the client retry loop is the biggest amplifier. If console keeps hammering at 200ms we will keep tripping the limiter. We should throttle client-side immediately via a config flip if needed.

alex_support: I've flagged the 3 impacted customers and paused further manual attempts. Assigning P0, cc-ing billing and ops. Will hold on reply to customers until we have a mitigation.

sre_bot: Incident created: INC-7789 — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-7789

maria_ops: Next steps: tim to push 429+Retry-After and logging; frontend team to remove optimistic success for manual grants; ops to monitor 429 rate and db write latency.

alex_support: Thanks — keep updates here.
